name: Messenger to Darkshire
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
narrative.objectives: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for making the long journey here. This is indeed important information.
narrative.requestItemsText: You appear to have traveled from afar, Champion. What business do you have here in Darkshire?

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 14 to 18, 2,820 XP in all.

quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind.

quests.name: Messenger to Stormwind
quests.objectiveText: Take General Marcus Jonathan's letter of response to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take his written plea to Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall.

quests.name: Messenger to Westfall
quests.objectiveText: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Gryan Stoutmantle's response.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.objectiveText: Magistrate Solomon wants you to take a letter to Lord Ebonlocke in Darkshire.

quests.name: Messenger to Darkshire
quests.objectiveText: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
